description: Test suite for Zalouser group policy helper functions, verifying normalization, candidate building, group entry searching, and enable/allow status evaluation.

methods.name: normalizeZalouserGroupSlug
methods.description: Normalizes group slug names by trimming and converting to lowercase hyphen-separated format.

methods.name: buildZalouserGroupCandidates
methods.description: Generates an array of candidate identifiers for a group based on provided options.

methods.name: findZalouserGroupEntry
methods.description: Finds the first matching group entry from a set of group candidates.

methods.name: isZalouserGroupEntryAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a group entry is allowed based on its enabled or allow flags.
